name: cascade
note: Calibrated by eye on live demo frames, 2026-10-15. Order is a priority list: the first matching step wins, so this is not the same as picking the strongest target above a threshold. Thresholds are strict (greater than). hand_back appears twice on purpose: above its threshold it wins outright, and below it it still wins whenever it is the strongest class of the four.
status_note: Chosen by eye on demo frames only. Must be re-checked on a held-out camera set before it counts as an acceptance rule; the offline validation split is a different domain.
